{{Top|leg}}
The '''Millennium blossom''' was a [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that could only be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lemmi VI]]. It blossomed once every 100 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and [[Death/Legends|died]] almost immediately after blooming.
